notes: topic_approval: 'auto' lets tools/auto_select.py approve the top eligible topic with logged reasons (the human reviews the finished video instead); 'human' restores the /approve-topic checkpoint. skip_ledger_statuses: topics with these statuses in the channel ledger (ledger.json on the gh-pages branch) are not selected again; remove 'rejected' to allow rejected topics to come back. series.plan_approval: 'required' means no episode of a series is made until you approve its plan once (./tools/human/approve_series.py series/<slug>, in your own terminal); 'optional' lets episodes start from the plan as written, with an informational note. 2026-11-01: set to 'optional' at the owner's request ('there is no need for me to approve the plan, i only want to approve the final video and i will upload it myself on youtube'); the series red team still checks every plan. Set it back to 'required' to approve plans again. series.final_cut_review: 'required' means the final-cut review of the assembled video (tools/gate.py --stage release) must exist and have no open blocker before the private upload (or, in a session, before the hand-over package). Edit this file yourself: Claude may not (the 2026-11-01 change was made on the owner's explicit request).
